title: feat(hooks): SessionStart hook prints the pm-dispatch pointer, its SKILL.md touch sha and the lane’s seat-post line

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DM24jRuzJ1rYKwcydPYYtYc)_

Fixes #25380

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:新增一个 `SessionStart` 钩子 `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh`,会话一开始就把三行话印进上下文:① 「先读 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 与阶段 references 再派发/认领/复核/落地」的指针;② 本检出上 SKILL.md 最近一次触碰的 sha(供席位与开轮标记比对;浅克隆边界会被明确标出、不冒充真触碰);③ 车道行:环境里有 `OS_FLEET_LANE` 就印该车道的席位贴号与「席位贴只是存根,姿态与台账住项目里」的提醒,没有就印 `lane: not set`。配套 selftest(58 例)、`settings.json` 注册一条、`seat-lifecycle.md` 加一行点名钩子(删一行已由 SKILL.md 索引承载的读者路由句付账,96→95 行,上限不动)。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-10-23 的原话:「包括Claude code projects 我打开之后怎么让他自动加载相关的技能要求。」「同意,你现在就立卡派发处理。」多仓项目线程的工作目录是三个检出的父目录,嵌套检出的 `.claude/skills` 进不了技能列表,两天来每条席位线程都是靠项目指令手读 SKILL.md。规则仍只住仓库里一份,钩子只印指针。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:钩子不联网、不读 GitHub、不写文件,恒 exit 0(连 `set -u` 中断都被 trap 收成 0),失败最多少印几行,不会挡会话;每次会话开始多 3–5 行上下文。一次 revert 可回(删钩子两文件 + settings 一段 + seat-lifecycle 一行)。两处实测要您知道:(a) 本卡线程里 `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` 未设、已有的 PreToolUse 守卫对一条已知应拦的命令没有拦——即 objectstack 的 `settings.json` 在这种「父目录开会话」的线程里很可能根本没被加载(或 `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` 指向父目录),那样本钩子在项目线程里同样不会触发;单仓会话与 CI 自检不受影响。(b) `references/lanes/*.md` 目前没有任何一份写了席位贴号,钩子如实印「not recorded」;补号是各车道文件各加一行 `Seat post: #N`,不在本卡范围。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:席位复审 PASS 后,一句「可以落地」;若要让项目线程真的触发它,还需确认平台是否加载嵌套检出的 `settings.json`(见 A1)。

## What changed

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh` (new) | `SessionStart` hook. Prints the pointer line, the SKILL.md path and its latest touch on HEAD, an optional one-line note when `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is not this checkout, and the lane line. Dependency-free bash (3.2 floor), no jq, no network, no GitHub read, no write; `trap 'exit 0' EXIT` so it exits 0 under every input measured (closed/empty/malformed stdin, no git on PATH, no checkout, no SKILL.md, a refused lane value, an `-u` abort). Everything is resolved from the hook's own path, never the cwd. |
| `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.selftest.sh` (new) | 58 cases on a hermetic fixture checkout (git repo + SKILL.md + two lane files, one with `Seat post: #19287`, one without): pointer verbatim, touch sha = `git log -1 -- SKILL.md`, shallow-boundary labelling (the fixture's touch commit written into the git dir's `shallow` file flips the wording and removing it flips it back), lane set / unset / empty / no file / no number / path characters / shell metacharacters, cwd and `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` not being inputs, ≤15 lines, `bash -n` and the executable bit (the bash-3.2 floor itself is `check:bash32-floor`'s, repo-wide), the `settings.json` wiring (registered on `SessionStart`, sibling spelling, not also a `PreToolUse` guard), and a NON-VACUITY tail (a mutated pointer, an `exit 1` copy and a `set -u` abort are each caught or held). Discovered by the existing `find .claude/hooks -name '*.selftest.sh'` step in `lint.yml`, so CI runs it with no workflow edit. |
| `.claude/settings.json` | one `hooks.SessionStart` entry: `"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh"`, the sibling spelling. `permissions` untouched (`check:pm-settings-deny-roster` green). |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` | +1 line in 〈开轮互斥〉 under the harness-current line: `- \`session-start-fleet.sh\` 钩子开会话即印 SKILL.md 触碰 sha 与车道席位贴行,供比对开轮标记。` (115 bytes). −1 line: the opening reader-routing sentence 「每个座位每次 fire 读本文:…」, whose content the SKILL.md 〈阶段细则索引〉 row for this file already carries (reader + both read moments). 96 → 95 lines; the ceiling row stays 96 (headroom 1, no ratchet edit). Placed away from L69 (PR #25348) and from 〈座位贴协议〉 (#25379). ⛔ Not a second copy of the pointer text. |

## The exact lines the hook prints

On this branch's checkout (HEAD `e75a6b53`, a shallow clone), no `OS_FLEET_LANE`:

```text
Fleet protocol: read .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (and the stage references its index names) before any dispatch, claim, review or landing act.
  SKILL.md: /home/claude/objectstack/.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md
  touch: 8010b641 is this SHALLOW clone's boundary, not a measured touch of SKILL.md (HEAD e75a6b53); the real touch is older than the clone holds — deepen (git fetch --deepen=N origin) or read it from a full checkout before comparing with an opening mark.
lane: not set (OS_FLEET_LANE names the lane; set it in the environment this hook runs in — the project's instructions or the agent's launch environment).
```

With `OS_FLEET_LANE=skills`, the last line becomes:

```text
lane: skills · seat post: not recorded in .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md (no `Seat post: #N` line); read the pm:seat index for it; the seat post is a stub; posture and ledger live in the project.
```

On a full clone the touch line reads `touch: SHA — latest commit touching SKILL.md on HEAD SHA; compare with the opening mark (seat-lifecycle.md 〈开轮互斥〉) before the round.`; with a lane file carrying `Seat post: #19287` the lane line reads `lane: skills · seat post #19287 (.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md); the seat post is a stub; posture and ledger live in the project.` (both pinned by the self-test). When `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is set and is not this checkout, one more line is printed: `  note: this session's project dir is not this checkout, so the harness's skill list does not include this checkout's .claude/skills — hence this pointer.`

The shallow-boundary wording is not decoration: `8010b64` is in this clone's `.git/shallow`, and `git log -1 -- SKILL.md` names it only because the graft makes the boundary look like it touched every path — the exact fabrication `check-harness-current.mjs`'s header documents. On `origin/main` from a full checkout the real touch is older; the hook refuses to present the boundary as a reading.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured (dispatch A1–A4)

- **A1 — does a hook registered in `objectstack/.claude/settings.json` fire in a project thread, and what does it see?** Measured from this card thread (working directory `/home/claude` at start, the parent of the three checkouts): `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is **unset** in the Bash tool's environment, and the registered PreToolUse guard `guard-tree-enum.sh` did **not** block `for f in .github/workflows/*.yml; do git show "origin/main:$f" | head -1; done` — its own self-test's first measured block case — the command ran and printed. So in this thread shape either the nested checkout's `settings.json` is not loaded at all, or `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` resolves to the parent, where `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/…` does not exist and the hook command fails non-blocking. This contradicts the card's premise that the guards fire in card threads; it may differ by how a thread is rooted. Consequence: the hook is correct and self-tested, but whether a project thread ever runs it is a platform question, not something this PR can settle. The hook locates SKILL.md from its own path, so wherever it IS run it prints the right checkout. A registration that also looks under `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/objectstack/…` would not help if the file is not loaded, so the sibling spelling is kept rather than guessing.
- **A2 — "verified once from a project thread".** Not observable before merge: the harness reads `settings.json` from the primary checkout at session start and does not reload it, and the measured thread does not run the registered hooks at all (A1). ⛔ Not claimed. The self-test evidence and the exact lines above stand in; the first post-merge project thread that shows the pointer in its first context is the acceptance reading, recorded by the seat.
- **A3 — `seat-lifecycle.md` placement.** One line in 〈开轮互斥〉 (L21 after the edit), away from L69 (#25348, which only rewords that line and moves no ceiling) and from 〈座位贴协议〉 (#25379). `origin/main` merged when the seat says so.
- **A4 — `OS_FLEET_LANE` spelling.** `git grep` over `scripts/`, `.claude/`, `.github/`: no script reads a lane name from the environment under any spelling (`OS_LANE_STEPS` / `OS_LANE_JOB_STATUS` in `lint.yml` are the CI lane-verdict inputs, a different thing). `OS_FLEET_LANE` is new and collides with nothing; it follows the `OS_FLEET_*` family (`fleet-token.mjs`, `fleet-write/**`).
- **A5 (found, not assumed) — the seat-post number is not in any lane file.** `references/lanes/*.md` carry no `#N` at all (`grep -rn '19287\|6023\|1353' .claude/` is empty); seat posts are found by the `pm:seat` label index. The hook reads an optional line `Seat post: #N` from the lane file as the card specifies and says `not recorded` when absent. Writing those lines is one line per lane file, outside this card's file surface — carrier: the skills seat (a follow-up card or a rider on #25379's reference edit).

## Verification

- `bash .claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.selftest.sh` → `58 passed, 0 failed`, exit 0 (log in the PR's verification comment). Hook exits 0 with and without `OS_FLEET_LANE`, on a checkout with no SKILL.md, in a directory that is no checkout, with no git on PATH, with closed, empty and malformed stdin.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual changed set (4 paths, 392 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold): 19 commands derived (`--commands`, no paths — the tool took the change set off the merge base itself), every one run on head `e75a6b53` with its exit code captured before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran`: `19 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, all exit 0. The list: check-closing-keyword-parity (+ --self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-harness-current --self-test, lint `check:doc-formula-expressions` (exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET on the first sweep until `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were built; exit 0 on the final sweep), check:agent-test-spelling, check:bash32-floor (red on the first sweep — the selftest had spelled the forbidden tokens into a grep pattern; fixed in the second commit, green since), check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:doc-authoring, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:pm-governed-merges, check:pm-settings-deny-roster, check:pm-skill-id-lint, check:pm-skill-ratchet, check:refd-timer-probe, check:skill-frame-sync, check:watch-hint-literal. Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the hook self-test discovery step, the type-check lanes) are CI's; this PR's check-runs are the reading for those.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: green — `seat-lifecycle.md` 95 lines against its ceiling 96 (headroom 1; the ceiling row is not moved), every edited line ≤120 bytes (the new line is 115), no cross-file move declared.
- The hook's own text carries no issue number (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` covers the skill files; the hook is read by `check:doc-authoring` and `check:bash32-floor`, both in the derived list).

## Acceptance notes

- `references/lanes/*.md` carry no `Seat post: #N` line (A5) — carrier: skills seat; noted, not filed.
- The project-thread hook question (A1): this thread's registered PreToolUse guards do not fire, with `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` unset in the tool environment — a platform reading for the seat's `platform-readings.md` fact table (reference edits are outside this card). Carrier: skills seat; noted, not filed.

Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S): draft, awaiting the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and the maintainer's word; ⛔ not to be flipped ready, queued or armed by this thread. `skip-changeset`: no published package is touched (`.claude/**` and a reference file only).
